## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      3 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Jul 21, 2026 - Aug 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mushyyn Elvz_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "Reduce the one time pay fee on the app, the ads are getting increasingly intrusive and longer in duration, I use this app but despise the ads and overly costly onetime fee, that now I force close the app and reopen just to bypass the increasingly intrusive ads that play right in the middle I am adding expenses. as of July 31, 2026 I can no longer use the app without having to sign up for a trial subscription, this app has gotten worse over time and would pass this one over."
            2. _John Smith_, Aug 1, 2026, 2/5: "Works great, and has a good couple features. Ads arnt intrusive Update: the ads are now incredibly intrusive, I used to give this a 4/5. Would be happy to pay for it, but £40 a year subscription is out of the question."
            3. _Shaehan M!4h_, Jul 21, 2026, 2/5: "I paid subscription not to display ads but its not worth it because its confusing as the app has two different icons one on the android homepage/desktop and another on the playstore. I was told to email, i did that but no response. So i will not be using this app anymore because its so confusing what your paying for. So, either make the icons same or stop putting on ads whos gonna pay for an app that confuses what you're paying for."
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Review examples:**
